answer: The oasis test I would run is Storj node audit history: a node that passed audits for a year, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the prism of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the timber of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
